overview_description.description: Maison Safqa is an e-commerce platform specialising in flash sales for premium and luxury brands, offering customers limited-time deals on fashion, beauty, and lifestyle products. The platform connects luxury brands with shoppers by organising curated online sales events where products are sold at discounted prices for a short period.
